title: Cooperative prefill throttler and lazy-decode trigger to reduce KV-cache stalls
author: Anya Petrov
description: Motivation: In high-concurrency workloads we observed tail latency regressions caused by aggressive prefill batching that floods KV cache and forces frequent soft-evictions; this PR introduces a cooperative prefill throttler plus a lazy-decode trigger to reduce KV churn and smooth kernel utilization. Design summary: (1) Prefill throttler: token-window based admission that coordinates across worker threads using a light-weight sequence ring so simultaneous prefill bursts are spread over a configurable jitter window. (2) Backpressure signal: prefills that detect elevated KV miss ratio emit a transient backpressure mark propagated to the router to preferentially route new requests to decode-first lanes or lower concurrency workers. (3) Lazy-decode trigger: small speculative decode activation that waits for a short micro-window before kicking off full decode kernels if prefill progress stalls; this reduces wasted prefill work when requests are likely to be followed by immediate decode activity. (4) Kernel steering hints: dispatch includes a kernel hint flag (latency-optimized vs throughput-optimized) inferred from throttler state to select the best convolution/attention kernel. Checklist: - [x] unit tests for throttler logic - [x] integration test with kv-cache simulator - [x] new metrics (prefill_window_ms, prefill_backpressure_ratio) - [x] dry-run telemetry enabled behind flag - [x] e2e perf run across small, medium, burst traffic. Impact: 10-18% p99 latency reduction on synth burst workloads and 6% token-cost reduction from fewer reissued prefill ops. Rollout plan: behind feature flag pref_coop_throttle_v1 -> canary in eu-west-1 -> ramp to 30% traffic -> monitor kv eviction rate and cost-per-token. Related linear: ENG-2894 ENG-3010. This description contains implementation notes, high-level algorithm, and rollout instructions in a single contiguous string as required.
commits: feat(prefill): add cooperative prefill throttler and sequence ring
perf(router): emit backpressure mark on kv miss rate spike
feat(runtime): lazy-decode trigger and kernel hint plumbing
test(prefill): add kv-cache simulator integration tests
review_comments: Ethan Cole: Can we make the jitter window adaptive to observed inter-arrival times? Suggest adding a config path to tie it to percentiles.
Anya Petrov: Added adaptive window config; default still 25ms, can be tuned via runtime flag.
Marina Alvarez: Need to ensure lazy-decode doesn't increase GPU warmup overhead for cold requests. Request adding a quick test measuring kernel startup counts.
Anya Petrov: Added micro-benchmark measuring decode kernel activations; numbers look stable within noise.
Jasper Liu: Approve after CI green and one more perf run on heavy kv-eviction scenario.
release_notes: Add cooperative prefill throttler with KV backpressure signaling and lazy-decode trigger to reduce tail latency and KV-cache churn. Behind feature flag pref_coop_throttle_v1. See observability metrics: prefill_window_ms, prefill_backpressure_ratio.

squash: cooperative prefill throttler + lazy-decode trigger

Implements admission-controlled prefill bursts, backpressure propagation to router, and a lazy decode activation path to reduce KV-cache evictions and unnecessary prefill work. Includes tests and telemetry.
